RETIREMENT  ADMIN  The City  Council  waived  the reading  in full  and introduced  Ordinance  No.
  2024-04-CC  entitled  Ordinance  of the City  Council  of the City  of South
  Gate, California,  authorizing  an amendment  to the contract  between  the
  City  and the Board  of Administration  of the California  Public  Employees'
  Retirement  System  implementing  Section  20516  (Employees  Sharing
  Additional  Cost) to provide  employee  cost sharing  of an additional  1% for
  the local miscellaneous  members  in the DMA  (for a total of 2%),  an
  additional  1% for the classic  local police  officers  in the PMA  (for a total of
  2%),  and for an initial  1% for new ("PEPRA")  local police  members  in
  both the POA  and PMA  by motion  of Mayor  Hurtado  and seconded  by
  Vice  Mayor  Davila.

  ROLL  CALL:  Council  Member  Avalos,  yes; Council  Member  Rios,  yes;
  Vice Mayor  Davila,  yes; Mayor  Hurtado,  yes.

  Jon Hamilton,  Director  of Human  Resources  provided  a presentation.

  Mayor  Hurtado  asked if anyone  in the audience  wished  to speak on this
  item or if any emails  were received.  Seeing  no one step forward  nor
  emails  received;  Mayor  Hurtado  closed  the audience  portion.

  drug  trafficking  bust  by our narcotics  team.  Proud  of our team.

  Trunk  O' Treat  Event,  Thursday,  October  24, 2024,  from  5pm-8pm.

  meetings  it is considered  a public  forum.  Outside  of council  meetings
  there  are laws  against  harassment  and bullying.

  Regarding  our City  Attorney.  Mr.  Salinas  has done  amazing  things  within

  our city  and does what  it takes  to abide  by the law.  He is unable  to discuss

  legal  matters  to maintain  the integrity  of the legal  system.

  Regarding  blocking  comments  - We are to provide  a service  to our

  community  but when  someone  acts in a bad manner  against  our staff  - We

  have the obligation  to protect  our staff.

  Freedom  of Speech  is protected  by our Constitution.  A City  Council

  meeting  is an open  forum.  You  can say anything  you  want.  Once  the

  meeting  ends,  we will  protect  our staff.

  The law  is on our side!

  Mayor  Hurtado  announced  Fernando  Valenzuela,  former  Los Angeles

  Dodger  pitcher  passed  away  today.  He was sixty-three  years  old.

ENGINEERINGADMIN  The City  Council  approved  items A, B, C, D, E & F during  Consent
  Calendar:

  a.  Agreements  for As-Needed  Engineering  Services  with  Interwest
  Consulting  Group  (Contract  No. 2024-84-CC),  NV5  Inc. (Contract  No.
  2024-85-CC)  and SAAssociates  (Contract  No. 2024-86-CC)  for a

  additional  years;

  b.  Agreement  (Contract  No. 2024-87-CC)  for As-Needed  Professional
  Engineering  and Project  Management  Services  with  Willdan
  Engineering  to provide  for a three (3) year term,  with  an option  to
  extend  the contract  for two (2) additional  years;

  c.  Authorized  the use of purchase  orders  in directing  work  to Interwest
  Consulting  Group,  NV5  Inc.,  SAAssociates  and Willdan  Engineering
  in an amount  not-to-exceed  $448,000  in the aggregate  all four
  contractors  for As-Needed  Engineering  Services;

  d.  Authorized  the use of purchase  orders  in directing  Willdan
  Engineering  to provide  As-Needed  Project  Management  Services  an
  amount  not-to-exceed  $300,000  per year;

  e.  Authorized  the City  Manager  to administratively  approve  amendments
  up to the aggregate  sum of $100,000  for each agreement  not to exceed
  $400,000  in total;  and

  f.  Authorized  the Mayor  to execute  the Agreements  in a form  acceptable
  to the City Attorney.

  Councilwoman  Avalos  does not feel comfortable  authorizing  City
  Manager  to approve  contract  amendments.  She agrees with  A, B, C, D & F
  but not E. This item should  return  to Council  and have Council  vote on
  that item.

CITY  COUNCIL  The  City  Council  received  and filed  an update  of the Council

  Strategic  Priority  Projects  by motion  of Council  Member  Avalos  and

  seconded  by Vice  Mayor  Davila.

  ROLL  CALL:  Council  Member  Avalos,  yes;  Council  Member  Rios,  yes;

  Vice  Mayor  Davila,  yes; Mayor  Hurtado,  yes.

  Rob  Houston,  City  Manager  stated  that  in March  28, 2024,  the City

  Council  and Director  staff  had a strategic  planning  session.  He gave  an

  update  to City  Council  and the community.

  Mario  Dominguez,  Jr. informed  Council  how  the City  of Downey  include

  their  residents  during  strategic  meetings.  Mr.  Dominguez  feels  the City  of

  South  Gate excludes  the residents  from  participating  in any strategic

  MEETINGS.
